myCv.copyAria: Copy the request for your agent
myCv.askAgent: Ask your agent to turn it into a template (only once; after that it uses no quota):
myCv.recreated: From {{format}} the agent recreates the design in HTML: it'll look very similar, but not exact, and it only produces PDF. It needs an agent that can see images. If you have the Word file, upload it: it's kept as is.
myCv.htmlOnly: HTML template: PDF only. If a job board asks for Word, render that CV with a docx template.
myCv.previewHint: The preview with your profile is indicative (the first achievements of each experience); the first time takes a few seconds. Your agent writes each tailored CV for the job.
myCv.title: My CV
myCv.intro: Upload your CV and your agent turns it into a template once. From then on, every tailored CV comes out with your design and your section order, with the text adapted to the job from your profile.
myCv.none: You haven't uploaded your CV yet
myCv.noneHint: Ideally in Word (.docx): the design is kept exactly. Maximum 10 MB.

title: CV templates
intro: Your agent writes the content of each CV; the template only decides how it looks. You can change it on each job's page without using AI again.
